meta.title: SlickTok — TikTok video downloader, no watermark, no ads

hero.eyebrow: Free · Open source · No ads, ever
hero.title: Download TikTok videos, minus the watermark.
hero.subtitle: Paste a link, get an HD, watermark-free file back. No account, no tracking, nothing installed.

how.title: Three steps, no detours
how.step1Body: In the TikTok app, tap Share, then Copy link.
how.step2Body: Works with full tiktok.com links and short vm.tiktok.com links.
how.step3Body: Download the watermark-free video straight to your device.

features.title: What SlickTok does
features.f1Body: Downloads use TikTok's own clean playback file — nothing stamped on top.
features.f2Body: No ad slots, no popups, no "watch an ad for HD." It's just the tool.
features.f3Body: Every line is public. Read it, fork it, self-host your own copy.
features.f4Body: Nothing to sign up for. Rate-limited by IP, not by login.
features.f5Body: If TikTok served a higher-resolution version, SlickTok offers it too.
features.f6Body: Photo posts are supported on a best-effort basis, background music included.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Does SlickTok add a watermark of its own?
faq.a1: No. The file you get is the same one TikTok's own app plays back internally, before any watermark is added for sharing.
faq.a2: No. There's no login anywhere on this site. Usage is limited per IP address instead, to keep the server available for everyone.
faq.a3: Full links like tiktok.com/@user/video/123…, and short links like vm.tiktok.com/xxxxx/.
faq.a4: No. SlickTok is an independent, unaffiliated open-source project. It is not made, endorsed, or supported by TikTok or ByteDance Ltd.
faq.q5: Can I run my own copy?
faq.a5: Yes — that's the point. The full source and a deployment guide are in the repository linked in the footer.
faq.q6: Am I allowed to download any video I want?
faq.a6: Only download videos you own, have permission to save, or that you're viewing for personal, non-infringing use. See the Terms for details.

notice.text: SlickTok is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to TikTok or ByteDance Ltd. Please only download content you have the right to save. See the Terms and Privacy Policy.
